scope: Explicit screen/window capture through the existing Live visual input owner
implementation: Share screen in the existing drawer invokes getDisplayMedia synchronously from an explicit user click, with audio:false.
Camera and screen share live_video.js and the existing LiveVideo/request-scoped bridge; one source at a time and no additional model connection or executor.
Local muted preview, fresh selection on each enable, no saved display ID/grant/frame and no automatic reacquisition.
Screen frames scale to at most 1280 pixels longest edge, camera remains 640; both retain 256 KiB JPEG, latest-only, expiry, sequence and socket cadence limits.
Off and platform end release tracks and clear preview without cancelling the microphone/reply. Stop closes this turn's transmission; existing sleep/Disconnect/scope/unknown cleanup releases capture.
Camera permission probes do not mistake screen capture for camera access. Screen content is untrusted data in the shared model instruction.

screen_browser_coverage: Native readiness guard and actual browser user activation at picker invocation
Video-only constraints, one source, bounded 1280x720 JPEG from a 1920x1080 canvas and local preview
No idle frame transport; shared request envelopes, visual Off closure and reply preserved
New selection on re-enable, platform end and reload cleanup
Denied/cancelled/unsupported capture, unexpected audio rejection, timed-out and late grant cleanup
Model/key/Disconnect cleanup; camera device changes preserve the active screen
Camera permission probe remains independent while the screen is active

full_native_attempt.status: failed; not a clean full regression
full_native_attempt.failure: Native child process exceeded 60 seconds during WebView2/WinForms window bootstrap before chat assertions.
full_native_attempt.root_cause: Not established. Earlier intermittent native startup/teardown instability remains open; no assertion that this feature caused or fixed it.

initial_regression_correction: The first expanded visual-input instruction exceeded the existing combined prompt bound by nine characters. The wording was shortened without relaxing validation; focused and subsequent full pytest passed.
manual_test: Use the updated source app and an awake, ready Live model; turn Camera Off.
Open the bottom-right Screen sharing controls, enable Share screen and choose a non-sensitive window. Check the local preview; cancel once and confirm sharing remains Off.
Ask Describe the window I am sharing. Confirm the answer matches visible content.
While Vex replies, turn Share screen Off. Preview/capture should stop while the microphone/reply continues.
Enable again and use the platform Stop sharing control; the app should show Off. Sleep/Disconnect should also release capture, without automatically reopening after wake/reconnect.
limits: Actual source-picker interaction and real-provider screen understanding require user acceptance. Synthetic tests capture canvas streams, never the user's desktop.
No system audio, simultaneous camera/screen sources, GUI clicking/inspection tools or file attachments in this slice.
Drawer close hides the preview but does not turn sharing Off. Idle pixels stay local; sent images may remain in provider context and cannot be recalled.
Small text, protected/minimized windows and OS/browser policy can limit capture/understanding; do not claim universal content support.
The full native attempt failed at chat bootstrap; targeted success does not close native startup/teardown stability.
Provider separation remains partial and planned. No new SDK dependency was added to core/domain tools.
No paid API, real desktop/camera capture or real-profile mutation. No demo rebuild, commit or push.
